title: Short and Sweet Tour of Georgia - 4 days
highlights: Explore Tbilisi, a city of contrasts blending history and modernity.
Discover Mtskheta, the ancient capital and spiritual heart of Georgia.
Visit Jvari Monastery and Svetitskhoveli Cathedral, both UNESCO World Heritage sites.
Experience the Kakheti wine region and its centuries-old winemaking traditions.
Stroll through Sighnaghi, the City of Love.
Join a Georgian breadmaking masterclass and taste freshly baked puri.
Enjoy an exclusive wine-tasting session in a traditional Georgian winery.
Enjoy hassle-free airport transfers and comfortable accommodation.
overview: Embark on an unforgettable journey through Georgia, where ancient traditions, breathtaking landscapes and rich history come together. This carefully crafted four-day tour takes you from vibrant Tbilisi to the spiritual sites of Mtskheta, the vineyards of Kakheti and the romantic charm of Sighnaghi. Enjoy authentic culinary experiences, UNESCO World Heritage sites, traditional breadmaking and Georgian wine tasting.

sections.title: Discover the Heart of the Caucasus
paragraphs: Begin in Tbilisi, where ancient streets, vibrant culture and warm hospitality meet. Continue to Mtskheta, Georgia’s ancient capital, and explore Jvari Monastery and Svetitskhoveli Cathedral.
Travel through Kakheti, visit Bodbe Monastery and Sighnaghi, and enjoy wine tasting alongside a traditional Georgian breadmaking class.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Tbilisi and Hotel Transfer
description: Private transfer to your hotel and check-in after 3:00 PM.
Enjoy a free evening and overnight in Tbilisi.

itinerary.description: Travel through Kakheti, visit Bodbe Monastery and Sighnaghi, enjoy Georgian wine tasting and participate in a traditional breadmaking masterclass.
